words.text: [some confusion, the microphone may have fallen and frightened Aunt Phoebe]
[speaking across Guy S. Lowman and Emily]
[indistinct conversation occurs before Guy S. Lowman (?) says]:
[Used to find him in a minute, right there (?].
[Guy S. Lowman (?) makes an indistinct remark]
[Mrs. John Faulconer Ware (?) joins the laughter]
